summary: Join our Leadership and Communications Course to boost your interpersonal skills. Learn to lead with confidence and communicate effectively in any situation.
lede: Communication and interpersonal skills training develops practical ways to guide teams, align stakeholders, and address workplace conflict. It is designed for project managers, operations leaders, HR business partners, technical team leads, and change specialists who need to move work forward with others. Participants practice adapting communication styles, giving structured feedback, resolving disputes, and planning stakeholder conversations.
audienceIntro: This program is structured for professionals who must navigate complex human dynamics, influence peers, and drive team execution across matrixed or hybrid environments.
modules: Foundations of Leadership Communication and Behavioral Profiling
Digital Communication and Hybrid Team Governance
prerequisites: Participants should have a minimum of two years of professional experience in a corporate, public sector, or non-profit environment. While formal management experience is not strictly required, learners will benefit most if they currently lead projects, coordinate cross-functional teams, or anticipate transitioning into a supervisory role within the next six months. No specific software coding skills are necessary, but participants should be familiar with standard digital collaboration tools (e.g., MS Teams, Slack, Zoom) and basic organizational reporting structures.
